# Neovim

Neovim ports the default Neovim color scheme into Obsidian for both dark and light modes. Its recorded description states that only the colors are swapped and that Obsidian's layout and functionality are preserved.

![Neovim screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/slavafyi/obsidian-neovim/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Neovim"
    author: "slavafyi"
    repo:   "slavafyi/obsidian-neovim"
    slug:   "neovim"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/neovim"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/slavafyi/obsidian-neovim"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/slavafyi/obsidian-neovim/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply the default Neovim color scheme to Obsidian to match dark and light modes. Preserve Obsidian’s layout and functionality while swapping only the colors."
}
```
